summary.name: Star History
summary.one_liner: Star History is a website that charts and compares GitHub star counts over time for open source projects, and shows trending repositories by category.
use_cases: Compare star growth of several GitHub projects
Check how popular an open source project is over time
Research which open source tools are gaining traction
summary.what_it_does: The page lets users view and compare GitHub star history graphs for open source projects, according to its meta description. The visible page text is a ranked list of GitHub repositories in an AI Coding category, with star counts (for example, the top entry is listed at about 48.7k stars) and up/down rank-change markers. The list covers a window of Oct 21, 2026 to Oct 27, 2026. The page text does not describe the graphing interface itself in detail.
notable: Side-by-side comparison of GitHub star history graphs
Category rankings such as AI Coding with star counts and rank movement
Shows weekly update window for listed rankings
caveats: Page text does not state pricing or whether features require an account
Ranking data covers only the listed period shown on the page
